description: Deterministic Australia Post eParcel-style estimate. Billable weight per line = max(actual weight incl. packaging, cubing weight LxWxH/5000). A flat base fee covers the first 5 kg, then a per-kg rate applies. A state surcharge applies when the destination is outside the dispatch state and a remote surcharge applies to remote postcode prefixes. Every number below is configurable so no fee is hard-coded in business logic.
gst_treatment: Shipment fee is treated as GST-exclusive. The brief defines Total = Subtotal + GST + Shipment Fee with GST at 10% of the order subtotal only, so the courier charge is not taxed a second time.

auspost.reason: Estimated with the domestic formula above; the live Australia Post pricing API is not called.

tnt.reason: TNT integration is optional bonus work and has not been implemented, so the TNT-related shipment fee is displayed as A$0.00 as permitted by the brief.
